# C# adapter fixture notes

Source of truth: `src/diff/lang/adapters/csharp.rs` (+ `src/diff/lang/adapters/common.rs`).
All expectations below are derived strictly from what the source does today, not from
what "correct" C# visibility would be. Where the source is arguably wrong, it is called
out under **Known misses / suspected bugs** and the per-file expectation still follows
the source.

## File detection (`detect_files`)

- Matches any path whose extension is exactly `cs` (`p.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "cs")`).
- Case-sensitive: `.CS` / `.Cs` are NOT matched.
- No generated-file filtering: `*.designer.cs`, `*.g.cs`, `*.generated.cs` ARE matched and
  parsed like any other `.cs` (no `<auto-generated>` / `[GeneratedCode]` handling).

## Public-symbol rules (`parse_ast`), by emitted `kind`

Lines are read with `read_lines_safe` (files >5 MiB are skipped entirely). Each line is
`trim()`med. Empty lines and lines starting with `//` are skipped (this also skips `///`
doc comments). Everything else is processed — including `/* … */` block-comment lines and
code inside `#if false` (no preprocessor awareness).

Types are matched FIRST and `continue` the loop, so a type line is never also a member.

- `kind "class"` / `"interface"` / `"struct"` / `"enum"`:
  `type_keyword()` checks whether any whitespace token equals one of
  `class interface struct enum`. `extract_type_name()` takes the token immediately after
  the keyword and trims it at the first of `< : { ( ;`. **No visibility check** — the
  keyword only has to be present as a token, so `private`/`internal`/`protected` types are
  emitted too. Generic arity is stripped (`Repository<T>` -> `Repository`).
- `kind "method"`: only attempted if the (trimmed) line contains the literal substring
  `public ` (trailing space). The line has its trailing `;` stripped, then `rfind('(')`
  locates the LAST `(`. The name is the last whitespace token before that `(`, with
  generics stripped (`Echo<T>` -> `Echo`). Must be a valid identifier. Because `(` is
  tested first, an expression-bodied METHOD is still reported as `method`, not `property`.
  Constructors match this rule and are reported as `method` named after the type.
- `kind "property"`: requires `public ` and no `(`. Tries `=>` (expression-bodied
  property), else `{` (getter/setter block); name = last token before the marker, generics
  stripped, must be a valid identifier.

Valid identifier = first char alphabetic or `_`, remaining chars alphanumeric or `_`.

Deliberately NOT emitted (by construction): anything without `public ` (private /
internal / protected / `protected internal` / `private protected` members), public FIELDS
and constants/events (no `(`, `=>`, or `{`), indexers and operator overloads (the
candidate name fails `is_valid_identifier`), interface members written without an explicit
`public `, namespaces, `using`s, and `//`/`///` comment lines.

## Breaking definition (`detect_breaking_changes` + `basic_diff`)

`basic_diff()` compares symbol sets by **NAME only** (kind is ignored). `modified` is
always empty. `detect_breaking_changes` returns `!diff.removed.is_empty()`. Consequences:

- Breaking == a previously-present symbol NAME is absent in the new file (removal or
  rename). Renames look like remove + add.
- NOT breaking: signature/return-type/parameter/generic-arity changes that KEEP the same
  name; kind changes that keep the same name (e.g. method -> property); added symbols;
  body-only edits. None of these populate `removed`.

## Known misses / suspected bugs (NOT fixed — reported only)

1. **Type visibility ignored.** Any `class`/`interface`/`struct`/`enum` token emits a
   symbol regardless of `private`/`internal`/`protected`. The adapter is documented as
   detecting the *public* API, yet non-public types are counted. Demonstrated by
   `edge/visibility.cs`, `negative/private_members.cs`, `negative/internal_protected.cs`.
2. **Block comments not stripped.** A `/* public void X() */` line does not start with
   `//`, so it is parsed and emits a false `method`. Demonstrated in
   `edge/conditional_comments.cs` (`BlockCommentGhost`).
3. **String literals not stripped.** A line such as `var s = "public void Foo()";`
   contains `public ` and `(`, so it would emit a false `method Foo`. (Not given a
   dedicated fixture to keep the precision-negative clean; noted for the eval.)
4. **No conditional-compilation awareness.** Symbols inside `#if false` … `#endif` are
   still emitted. Demonstrated in `edge/conditional_comments.cs` (`Phantom`, `GhostMethod`).
5. **No generated-file exclusion.** `detect_files` matches every `.cs`; `*.designer.cs` /
   `*.g.cs` / `[GeneratedCode]` are not down-weighted or skipped (§8 generated class).
6. **`rfind('(')` + trailing initializer.** A property with an initializer, e.g.
   `public static Settings Instance { get; } = new Settings();`, is mis-read: after
   stripping only the final `;`, the last `(` is the `new Settings()` call, so the name
   becomes `Settings` (kind `method`) instead of `Instance` (kind `property`). Avoided in
   `positive/properties.cs` by dropping the initializer; reported here.
7. **`protected internal` under-detection.** It is part of C#'s externally-visible surface
   but lacks the literal `public ` token, so it is not flagged. Shown in
   `negative/internal_protected.cs`. (Arguably correct if "public" is taken literally.)
8. **Interface members without explicit `public ` are missed** (`void Greet();` inside an
   interface) — shown in `positive/interfaces_enums_structs.cs` (`Greet` not emitted).
9. **Constructors are counted as `method`** symbols named after the type — shown in
   `positive/constructors.cs` (duplicate name `Factory`, kinds `class` + `method`).
10. Extension match is lowercase-only (`.CS` not matched).

## Per-file expectations

positive/

- `positive/classes.cs` -> expect symbols: `Greeter`(class), `Name`(property),
  `SayHello`(method). Exactly 3; `Console.WriteLine` is not analyzed (no `public `).
- `positive/interfaces_enums_structs.cs` -> expect `IGreeter`(interface), `Color`(enum),
  `Point`(struct). `Greet` (interface member, no `public `) NOT emitted; field `X` NOT
  emitted.
- `positive/methods_variants.cs` -> expect `Service`(class), `Main`(method), `Add`(method),
  `GetItems`(method, generic stripped), `FetchAsync`(method). Expression-bodied methods
  with `(` are `method`, not `property`.
- `positive/properties.cs` -> expect `Settings`(class), `Name`(property), `Count`(property),
  `Ratio`(property via `=>`), `Instance`(property via `{`). Exactly 5.
- `positive/constructors.cs` -> expect `Factory`(class), `Factory`(method — the
  constructor), `Create`(method). Two symbols share the name `Factory` (kinds differ).

negative/

- `negative/private_members.cs` -> expect 0 method/property symbols; the enclosing
  `Holder`(class) IS still emitted (types ignore visibility — see bug 1). Net: 1 symbol,
  kind `class`.
- `negative/comments_and_strings.cs` -> expect 0 symbols: `using`s ignored, `//` and `///`
  comment lines skipped, the plain string and `Console.WriteLine` call have no `public `
  and are not analyzed. (Top-level-statements file, no type keyword anywhere.)
- `negative/internal_protected.cs` -> expect 0 method/property symbols (`internal`,
  `protected`, `protected internal`, `private protected` all lack literal `public `);
  `Service`(class) IS emitted (bug 1). Net: 1 symbol, kind `class`.

breaking/ (all TRUE breaking per `!diff.removed.is_empty()`, name-based)

- `breaking/remove_method_before.cs` -> symbols: `Greeter`(class), `SayHello`(method),
  `Wave`(method).
- `breaking/remove_method_after.cs` -> symbols: `Greeter`(class), `Wave`(method).
  Diff: removed={SayHello} -> breaking=true.
- `breaking/remove_type_before.cs` -> symbols: `Greeter`(class), `SayHello`(method).
- `breaking/remove_type_after.cs` -> symbols: none. Diff: removed={Greeter, SayHello}
  -> breaking=true.
- `breaking/rename_method_before.cs` -> symbols: `Calc`(class), `Add`(method).
- `breaking/rename_method_after.cs` -> symbols: `Calc`(class), `Sum`(method).
  Diff: removed={Add}, added={Sum} -> breaking=true (rename == remove by name).

edge/

- `edge/generics.cs` (§8 Generics/templates) -> expect `Repository`(class, `<T>` stripped),
  `GetAll`(method, `<T>` stripped), `Echo`(method, `<T>` stripped). `where T : class`
  constraints do not break detection.
- `edge/visibility.cs` (§8 Visibility subtleties) -> expect 5 class symbols — `Outer`,
  `InnerPub`, `InnerIntl`, `InnerPriv`, `InnerProt` — ALL emitted regardless of
  public/internal/private/protected (bug 1). 0 member symbols.
- `edge/conditional_comments.cs` (§8 Conditional compilation + Encodings/comments) ->
  expect `Phantom`(class) and `GhostMethod`(method) emitted despite `#if false` (bug 4);
  `BlockCommentGhost`(method) emitted from inside `/* … */` (bug 2); plus `Real`(class),
  `Alive`(method). Total 5 symbols, two of which (`Phantom`+`GhostMethod`+`BlockCommentGhost`
  = 3) are arguably false/gapped.
